content.comment_body: Hello everyone, When installing [product_name] software, I encounter an error message. Could someone provide guidance on how to resolve this issue? A screenshot is attached.
Hi, Have you checked if your issue matches the one described in this forum thread? [url] Please specify which [product_name] software version and which operating system you are using.

Usually, you can continue to use [product_name] software despite this error, but communication with the hardware might not work. If you're using a USB cable, ensure the correct driver is installed. Confirm your PC is connected properly to the device using the recommended cable. In your Windows configuration screen, locate and manually select the proper COM port that the software should use. Using the latest version of [product_name] software is recommended. If you have a paid license, updates are typically free.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing installation errors with [product_name] software. It appears that, while the software generally works, hardware communication fails due to missing drivers, hardware connection issues, or incorrect COM port settings. Ambiguities in error messages and setup procedures make it difficult for new or less technical users to resolve these problems independently.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward installation of [product_name] software and immediate, hassle-free communication with hardware, without needing to perform manual troubleshooting steps.
